description: Temurin publish stage parameters. Triggers the downstream refactor_openjdk_release_tool job. Gated on PUBLISH_ARTIFACTS being true, RELEASE_TYPE being RELEASE or WEEKLY, and SCM_REF being set.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled.

parameters.name: PUBLISH_ARTIFACTS
parameters.description: Publish built artifacts to the release repository.

parameterGroups.name: Publish Configuration
parameterGroups.description: Parameters controlling the publish job behaviour.

parameters.name: OVERRIDE_PUBLISH_NAME
parameters.description: Override the publish tag name forwarded to the release tool. When set by the trigger pipeline (e.g. 'jdk-21.0.5+11-ea'), this value is used directly instead of being re-derived from SCM_REF. Leave empty for manual builds to use the default derivation.
